description:
**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**
 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
   

  

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Every sprint that ships depends on someone keeping ceremonies structured, blockers visible, and Jira data trustworthy. Without that, planning drifts, standups run long without resolving anything, and status reports stop reflecting what teams shipped. The Scrum Master owns that day\-to\-day discipline for one or more Platform teams, especially teams still building their agile habits, so the team can focus on delivery instead of process friction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Ceremony Facilitation**
* Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for assigned teams, keeping sessions time\-boxed and outcome\-focused
* Support charter reviews and team kickoffs, helping new or forming teams set working agreements and delivery expectations
* Document ceremony decisions and action items so commitments carry over cleanly between sprints


**Team Support \& Impediment Removal**
* Support teams new to agile in applying Scrum mechanics day to day, resolving confusion before it slows delivery
* Identify and escalate blockers quickly enough that they don't carry over into the next sprint
* Encourage open retrospectives and follow through on improvement commitments until they're implemented


**Jira \& Delivery Tracking**
* Maintain Jira boards and backlog health for assigned teams, keeping stories current and sprints configured correctly
* Track and report team\-level delivery metrics (velocity, sprint completion rate, open impediments) using Platform\-standard Jira dashboards
* Give stakeholders concise, accurate delivery status updates based on what the team completed


**AI\-Assisted Support**
* Use AI\-assisted tools to support ceremony prep, note capture, and status reporting, cutting down manual admin work


**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**
* 2\+ years working as a Scrum Master or in an agile delivery support role within a technology team
* Working knowledge of Scrum principles and ceremonies, with experience running or co\-facilitating them
* Familiarity with Jira for sprint tracking, story management, and basic dashboard configuration
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with a track record of keeping teams on track and following through on commitments
* Comfort supporting teams that are still building their agile practice, adjusting approach as the team matures


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Scrum certification (CSM, PSM I, or equivalent)
* Experience supporting technology teams in Software Engineering, IT infrastructure, or enterprise environments
* Comfort with AI productivity tools or interest in applying automation to reduce repetitive work
* Experience working within an organization with established agile standards


**Key Skills**
* Scrum ceremony facilitation
* Jira sprint and backlog management
* Impediment identification and escalation
* Stakeholder communication and status reporting
* Retrospective facilitation


**BUSINESS IMPACT**
* Builds consistent delivery habits in teams new to agile, improving sprint predictability over time
* Keeps delivery moving by resolving day\-to\-day blockers before they stall a sprint
* Gives Platform leadership accurate, current delivery visibility through disciplined Jira hygiene and status reporting


**Working Hours\- 3:00 PM\-12 PM IST**

description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 As an Engineering Manager you will ensure and support the hardware, software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible. You will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision and will encourage your team to self\-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus on their performance management and make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace.
   

  

 Description of the area
   

  

 The Digital Operations and Reliability function ensures the proactive management and maintenance of the optimal performance, reliability, and availability of all RDT enterprise\-wide digital platforms and Infrastructure, minimizing disruption to critical business processes across the value chain, and guaranteeing compliance.
   

  

 Global Operations provides 24x7 service support with the Change Advisory Board Team owning the change board processes and facilitating / coordinating the release processes for production deployments.
   

  

 This team will work in partnership with the Major Incident / Problem Management Team and will interface closely with the L1 Support Team.
   

  

 You will be :
   

  

* Team Member Capability and Career Development 🚀 Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision. Encourages team members to self\-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it. Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals. Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges
* Team Health and Sustainability 🌱 Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well\-being.Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication. Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team. Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined
* Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️
* Responsible for co\-creating the Product / Service Roadmap from a technical perspective, partnering with the Product Manager who is overall responsible. Accountable for the team's end\-to\-end delivery of features as part of the product development, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and quality standards. Sets clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps. Actively removes impediments and roadblocks to progress, escalating when necessary to protect the team's focus. Manages and aligns stakeholders' expectations and needs, providing regular updates on progress and risks. Creates efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible across teams and functions
* Performance \& Optimization ⏫ Defines success metrics, analyzes workforce capability trends, and identifies opportunities for optimization to achieve business goals. Translates data into actionable insights and regularly communicates delivery performance to stakeholders and the wider team. Identifies and implements process improvements within the team and in its interactions with other teams to boost efficiency and quality
* Financial \& Resource Mgmt.📈 Supports the development of detailed business cases for new products or significant features.Makes data\-driven decisions on how to allocate engineering, design, and other resources to maximize impact and achieve product goals.Manages the team's budget, including headcount, operational costs, and vendor contracts, ensuring financial responsibility


 Who you are :
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management, or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams. 2\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry
* Bachelor or advanced degree \& Business or IT specification \\
* Technical \& business skills . Understanding of software development and/or service delivery methodologies. Understanding of solution, information and process architecture. Ability to create clarity about outcomes generated by teams. Exhibits a lean \& agile mindset
* Leadership skills (where applicable) : Exhibits servant and creative leadership (VACC) behavior. Demonstrated experience building high performing teams. Have a keen IT market focus: you are passionate about major trends for the specific discipline. Demonstrates an executive presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manages complexity
* Manages risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity. Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries. Ability to empower teams and individuals to act autonomously and hold them accountable. Exhibits intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**Who are we:** 




 Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.
 



 CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.
 



 India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product \& process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.
 



  





**Lead Release Management Specialist.** 




**Function:** 
 Group Technology Operations (GTO) – Actuarial Solutions
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Skills Screening Summary:** 




**Who are we:** 




 Actuary IT Solutions is Zurich’s global capability within Finance, Investment \& Treasury (FIT), responsible for running, stabilising, and evolving shared actuarial platforms supporting IFRS and Group Reporting.
 



 Our portfolio includes core actuarial platforms such as
 **ACE, GNLA, GRAND and GLAD** 
 , operated as shared services with clear ownership, measurable KPIs and standardised processes. We are actively modernising this landscape, including a major migration to AWS targeted for Go\-Live in Q1 2027, to improve resilience, speed, cost efficiency and long\-term sustainability.
 



 India is an integral part of our global delivery model, working closely with international teams to support platform operations, change and transformation initiatives across the actuarial ecosystem.
 



  





**Why you’ll love working here:** 



* **Enterprise\-critical impact** 
 – Work on platforms supporting Zurich’s IFRS and Group Reporting.
* **Complex, meaningful delivery** 
 – Coordinate releases across globally used, multi\-component actuarial platforms.
* **Transformation at pace** 
 – Play a key role in the AWS migration programme.
* **AI\-enabled ways of working** 
 – Support AI\-first engineering, testing, operations and knowledge management.
* **Global collaboration** 
 – Work with teams across Hyderabad, Barcelona and other global locations.
* **Ownership and accountability** 
 – Drive decisions, solve complex problems and deliver measurable outcomes.



 If you enjoy working at the intersection of
 **release excellence and Agile delivery leadership** 
 , this role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to platforms critical to Zurich’s financial reporting and regulatory outcomes.
 



  





**Role Purpose:** 




 The
 **Release Manager \& Scrum Master** 
 will manage the end\-to\-end release lifecycle for the
 **ACE actuarial platform** 
 while leading Agile delivery for a geo\-dispersed team.
 



 This is a dual\-purpose role requiring strong ownership of release planning, coordination, governance and production readiness, alongside hands\-on Scrum Master responsibilities. The role acts as a key bridge between Hyderabad and global stakeholders, requiring proactive communication, strong stakeholder management and the ability to manage complexity under pressure.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




**Release Management:** 



* Own the end\-to\-end release lifecycle, including planning, scheduling, coordination and deployment across multiple environments and integrated components.
* Maintain release calendars, change windows and release plans aligned with business and regulatory timelines.
* Coordinate release readiness across Engineering, Testing and Business teams, ensuring required sign\-offs, test evidence and change controls are completed.
* Manage hotfixes, emergency releases and production incidents with structured communication and minimal business disruption.
* Maintain end\-to\-end release traceability through Azure DevOps.
* Take ownership of release quality, risk management and go/no\-go decisions.



  





**Scrum Master \& Agile Delivery:** 



* Facilitate all key Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives and backlog refinement.
* Remove impediments, manage scope creep and support realistic sprint commitments.
* Track sprint health, velocity and delivery metrics, proactively escalating risks where required.
* Coach teams on Agile principles and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy, prioritised backlog with clear acceptance criteria.
* Foster transparency, accountability and collaboration across distributed teams.



  





**Stakeholder Communication \& Governance:** 



* Provide clear and regular release and delivery updates to stakeholders across Hyderabad and global locations.
* Prepare release notes, deployment plans and post\-release reports.
* Represent delivery status in governance forums, highlighting risks, dependencies, decisions and upcoming milestones.
* Act as the Hyderabad focal point for release and sprint\-related coordination.



  





**AI\-First \& Continuous Improvement:** 



* Apply AI\-assisted tools to improve reporting, documentation, risk identification and delivery communications.
* Identify opportunities to reduce release cycle times, improve predictability and enhance sprint delivery.
* Apply critical thinking and professional judgement when evaluating AI\-generated outputs.



  





**Skills \& Experience:** 




**Required Experience:** 



* Minimum
 **7 years of experience** 
 in Release Management, Delivery Management or Agile/Scrum roles.
* Proven experience managing releases for large, complex, multi\-component enterprise applications.
* Strong hands\-on experience as a
 **primary Scrum Master** 
 , facilitating teams and removing delivery impediments.
* Experience working in financial services, insurance, banking or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams and stakeholders across time zones.



  





**Technical Skills:** 



* **Advanced hands\-on Azure DevOps experience is mandatory** 
 , including Boards, Pipelines, Release Management, Test Plans and Dashboards.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment coordination and change/release management processes.
* Familiarity with cloud environments, preferably Azure or AWS.
* Experience with delivery and ITSM tools such as Jira or ServiceNow is advantageous.



  





**Certifications:** 



* Active Scrum certification:
 **CSM, PSM I/II, SAFe Scrum Master or equivalent** 
 .
* ITIL Foundation or an equivalent Change/Release Management certification is advantageous.



  





**Professional Skills:** 



* Excellent written and verbal communication across technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple releases and delivery streams simultaneously.
* Structured approach to risk management, escalation and decision\-making.
* Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity and proactively communicate progress.
* Strong ownership mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.



  





**Education:** 




 Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 



  





**Candidate Data Privacy Notice:** 




 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that Zurich Insurance Group may collect and process your personal data for recruitment and selection purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws and Zurich’s privacy policy. You may request access, correction or deletion of your personal data through the appropriate HR channels.

Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, including 3–5\+ years in people leadership roles
* Proven experience managing medium\-to\-large, complex programs with multiple dependencies
* Experience in financial services or brokerage domain preferred Technical \& Leadership Expertise
* Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and enterprise software engineering practices
* Experience building and operating highly available, scalable distributed systems
* Hands\-on experience or strong exposure to mainframe and modern distributed ecosystems


**AI \& Modern Engineering Capabilities**
* Demonstrated experience driving AI\-assisted engineering adoption \& AI\-DLC
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, AI coding assistants) and their application in enterprise environments
* Understanding of automation, agentic workflows, and AI\-driven productivity acceleration (preferred practical exposure)
* Leadership \& Soft Skills
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and talent development capabilities
* Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to thrive in fast\-paced, globally distributed environments
* Self\-starter with strong prioritization and multitasking capabilities


**Technical Qualifications**
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, propose and implement timely, cost effective, quality solutions for all issues or problems within area of responsibility
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate technical discussions and drive solutions forward to achieve business needs and ensure alignment to strategic technology vision
* Demonstrated experience with designing or working with highly available and reliable systems including work on technical design, defining SLAs, KPIs for tracking and improving software reliability
* Experience facilitating issue intervention and driving improvements
* Skills in risks identification, tracking and planned mitigation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills


**Preferred Skills**

* Experience leading large\-scale modernization programs using GenAI and automation
* Proven ability to drive innovation, strategic initiatives, and cross\-functional programs

 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**

* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage

title: TD&E-FS-Technical Scrum Master- Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**echnology Consulting**
**Title:** 
**Specialist II, Technical Scrum Lead**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

**Client Technology (CT) \-** 
 focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
   

  

**Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) –** 
 EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
   

  

**Information Security (Info Sec) \-** 
 Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The Technical Scrum Lead, Specialist is responsible for driving Agile adoption and execution within technology teams, ensuring efficient sprint execution and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role involves facilitating Agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives, to keep teams aligned and productive.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead cross\-functional agile teams in iterative technology development, ensuring smooth collaboration and adherence to Agile/Scrum principles.
* Coach teams on best practices, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improving agile maturity.
* Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to define, prioritize and align technology\-related outcomes with business goals.
* Identify and proactively remove roadblocks that hinder project progress, ensuring teams have the necessary resources and support.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by maintaining transparency around scope, schedule and budget while effectively addressing concerns.
* Facilitate key agile ceremonies such as daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.
* Assist teams in estimating deliverables, increasing velocity and identifying opportunities for efficiency.
* Maintain product and sprint backlogs, ensuring tasks are documented, prioritized and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Apply agile methodologies to integrate changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology\-related product development.
* Serve as a mentor, thought leader and agile champion, participating in special projects to drive organizational agility.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in Agile project management, Scrum Master roles, or technical leadership in software development.
* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in Scrum, Kanban and SAFe frameworks, with a deep understanding of Agile principles and best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps and other Agile project management tools.
* Proficiency in coding and technical concepts, including Java, Angular, Node.js, POSTMAN, CUCUMBER, AWS and SQL queries.
* Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, TDD/BDD and monitoring tools like Splunk and Honeycomb.
* Experience in monitoring and refining dashboards, optimizing workflows, and driving continuous process improvements in Agile environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification and Professional Scrum Master (CSM, PSM, SAFe) certification is preferred.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship\-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)


**What We Look For**
* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well\-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Project Coordinator- Migration
description:
**Migration Coordinator** 




**Location: India \- Remote** 




  





**Job Profile Summary** 




 The Migration Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and governing day\-to\-day migration activities across multiple customers, workstreams, and technical teams. This role serves as the central coordination point between Project Managers, Program Managers, technical delivery teams, service management teams, customers, and third\-party partners to ensure migration activities are planned, scheduled, executed, and tracked in accordance with program objectives.
 



 The role combines migration coordination and PMO responsibilities, including migration wave scheduling, migration readiness management, customer communications, ServiceNow or any ticket governance, reporting, tracking of planned versus actual delivery status, and risk and dependency management. The Migration Coordinator is expected to maintain accurate migration data, provide visibility into program progress, proactively identify issues, and support effective program governance.
 



  





**Career Level Summary** 



* Manages routine and complex migration coordination activities across multiple customers and workstreams.
* Works with technical and business stakeholders to support migration planning, execution, and governance.



  





**Critical Competencies** 



* Excellence: Delivers high\-quality coordination and governance support through strong attention to detail, accountability, and consistent execution.
* Customer\-Driven: Ensures customers are informed, prepared, and supported throughout migration planning and execution activities.
* Expertise: Applies PMO and migration coordination knowledge to maintain control over schedules, readiness activities, reporting, governance, and ticket management processes.
* Collaboration: Builds effective working relationships across technical teams, program leadership, operational teams, customers, and external partners.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage day\-to\-day migration wave scheduling and coordination activities across multiple customers, services, applications, and infrastructure environments.
* Maintain migration schedules and ensure alignment with program milestones, migration roadmaps, and delivery objectives.
* Coordinate migration dates, resource availability, dependencies, readiness activities, and prerequisites required for successful execution.
* Track migration readiness and ensure required approvals; validations, access requirements, and prerequisites are completed before scheduled migration dates.
* Identify scheduling conflicts, resource constraints, delivery risks, and dependency\-related challenges, escalating where appropriate.
* Manage migration\-related customer communications, including scheduling notifications, reminders, status updates, confirmations, and follow\-up actions.
* Maintain high standards of ServiceNow or any other ticket management governance across migration activities.
* Ensure migration\-related tickets are accurately created, assigned, categorized, updated, reviewed, and closed according to agreed processes.
* Maintain migration trackers, action logs, RAID logs, readiness trackers, dashboards, and governance documentation.
* Maintain risk, issue, action, and dependency registers and ensure assigned owners actively progress in remediation activities.
* Act as the primary coordination point between migration teams, project managers, service management teams, operations, customers, and external vendors.



  





**Knowledge** 



* Knowledge of PMO methodologies, governance frameworks, reporting processes, and project coordination practices.
* Proven ability to identify schedule slippage, risks, dependencies, and blockers and drive appropriate follow\-up actions.



  





**Skills** 



* Migration Coordination
* PMO Governance and Reporting
* Migration Wave Planning and Scheduling
* Stakeholder Management (Internal and External)
* Customer Communication Management
* ServiceNow / ITSM Platforms
* Schedule Management and Tracking
* Migration Readiness Management
* Risk, Issue, Action and Dependency Management (RAID)
* Data Analysis and Reporting
* Microsoft Excel, Dashboards and Tracker Management



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields required.



  





**Certifications** 



* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent Project Management Certification preferred.
* Agile Foundation, Scrum Fundamentals, or comparable project delivery certification preferred.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 3\-6 years of experience in PMO, project coordination, migration coordination, transition management, service delivery, or related operational roles.

title: Senior Consultant – Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) – Data Technical Program Management
description:

**Position Summary**
 As a Senior consultant within the GES Technology Group, reporting to Digital delivery leader, you will work closely with Product and engineering functions to lead cross\-functional programs spanning data engineering, analytics, integration, architecture, product, security, and business stakeholders. You will drive delivery of scalable data platforms and integration solutions, including initiatives involving AI driven analytics, master data management, data lake enablement, APIs, event\-driven integrations, Model Context Protocol implementations and others.
   

  

 You will serve as the connective tissue across business, product, engineering, and leadership teams—ensuring that complex data and integration programs are delivered with clear outcomes, disciplined execution, and effective risk management.
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad
   

  

 Shift Timings: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
   

  

 Key job responsibilities:
   

  

* Own and manage the end\-to\-end Compliance PMO plan for software releases, including SSDLC governance milestones, approval dependencies, timelines, and escalation paths.
* Drive coordination of all required compliance approvals for releases, including BISO, quality, risk, data privacy, cyber, and other governance signoffs as applicable.
* Coordinate and gather information required for compliance documentation, including data privacy assessments, risk inputs, control evidence, and supporting artifacts from various product domain teams.
* Drive engagement with member firm and local geography risk leaders to socialize release scope, confirm required risk considerations, share evidence of global risk compliance process approvals and coordinate responses to questions pertaining to risk controls of the software and/or process.

* Experience coordinating cross\-functional compliance approvals across quality, risk, data privacy, cyber, engineering, QA, operations, and business stakeholders
* Ability to manage compliance trackers, release dashboards, approval artifacts, audit evidence, RAID logs, and executive\-ready status reporting

 The Engineering Manager position entails the leadership of MCO global product development teams across the entirety of the software development life cycle. This role focuses on our MEAN stack platform (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js) hosted on AWS, with MongoDB Atlas as the primary data layer. Key responsibilities encompass ensuring the quality of team outputs and optimizing customer experiences, along with maintaining strict adherence to coding standards and promoting automation initiatives.
 



 The role involves mentoring and guiding engineers, proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks, and facilitating effective communication between engineering and other stakeholders. The manager oversees deployment processes across AWS infrastructure, monitors system performance, and provides decisive technical leadership during incidents. Ultimately, this role aims to uphold the highest standards of professionalism and innovation in MCO software development practices.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Agile \& Team Leadership** 



* Own the effectiveness of the Scrum Agile process and adherence to good agile practices for the team.
* Be responsible for the quality of the teams’ outputs and the customer experience of our products.
* Lead product development teams through all stages of the SDLC, from requirements gathering through production deployment on AWS.
* Foster a collaborative and innovative engineering culture focused on delivering high\-quality software products.
* Mentor and coach engineers to foster their technical growth and career development, with emphasis on modern JavaScript/TypeScript best practices.



**Technical Leadership – MEAN Stack \& AWS** 



* Hands\-on participation in all technical activities including architecture and design reviews, code reviews, coding, troubleshooting, and defect triage across the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).
* Define and enforce coding standards and best practices within the engineering team for TypeScript/JavaScript, Angular component architecture, RESTful API design, and Node.js services.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure high code quality and adherence to engineering standards across the full stack.
* Oversee MongoDB Atlas configuration, schema design, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, and data migration processes.
* Drive architecture decisions for AWS services including EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, and related infrastructure.
* Identify technical risks and challenges early in the project lifecycle and propose mitigation strategies, particularly around scalability, security, and cloud cost optimisation.



**Delivery \& Operations** 



* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate product requirements into technical specifications.
* Drive automation in the engineering teams, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and automated testing.
* Drive continuous improvement in development processes and tools to increase efficiency and quality.
* Act as a technical liaison between engineering, product management, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Platform Test teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of software products.
* Oversee deployment and release processes using AWS\-based CI/CD to ensure smooth and reliable product launches.
* Monitor system performance via CloudWatch, application logging, and APM tooling; address technical issues promptly to maintain product stability.
* Provide technical leadership during incidents and outages, facilitating root cause analysis and resolution across the application and infrastructure layers.



**Experiences and Skills** 




**Required** 



* 10\+ years of experience in product development (including up to 3 years in engineering management).
* Strong full\-stack engineering experience with the MEAN stack: MongoDB, Express.js, Angular (2\+), and Node.js in a product development environment.
* Proven experience designing and operating production workloads on AWS, including services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, and RDS/DocumentDB or MongoDB Atlas.
* Hands\-on proficiency with MongoDB Atlas: cluster management, performance tuning, indexing, aggregation framework, change streams, and backup/restore strategies.
* Maintain hands\-on involvement with coding approximately 20% of the time.
* Expertise in architecture and design reviews, system design, code reviews, customer issues, troubleshooting, and defect triage.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex distributed\-systems issues.
* Demonstrates resilience and flexibility, consistently adapting while managing priorities with efficiency.
* A strong willingness to learn and a growth mindset.
* Excellent communication and servant\-leadership skills.
* Knowledge and experience of agile development methodology (Scrum, Agile, and Kanban).



**Preferred** 



* Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or CDK).
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS ECS/EKS).
* Experience with event\-driven architectures, message queues (SQS, SNS, Kafka), and microservices patterns.
* Background in a product\-driven SaaS or financial services company.



 Architect\-level experience is a plus.
